quarterly_data.signal: On August 24, 2026 Navitas entered into a definitive merger agreement to acquire Claros, Inc., a power management company developing vertical power delivery (VPD) and integrated voltage regulator (IVR) technology for next-generation AI data centers; Navitas says the deal would extend its AI infrastructure portfolio from the grid to the xPU alongside its GaN and HV/UHV SiC products. Closing is anticipated prior to December 31, 2026, subject to conditions including Hart-Scott-Rodino clearance. Navitas expects VPD and IVR to be an additional growth accelerator from 2028/2029 onward, with its short- to mid-term financial model unchanged.
quarterly_data.figure: VPD/IVR growth accelerator from 2028/2029 onward; closing anticipated prior to December 31, 2026
